Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: Identified that checkout-api's latest release v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Verified the service is now healthy with the error rate back down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure, the rollback, and the current state. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still unknown — the on-call engineer will investigate.
